dialogues.jp: 「……コーヒでも飲も」
dialogues.en:
I don't know why but I quietly tiptoe closer to her. And I
hear the sound of her sleeping breath.
dialogues.text:
I don't know why but I quietly tiptoe closer to her. And I
hear the sound of her sleeping breath.

dialogues.jp:
関西風に呟きつつ、ごろっとベッドから起きあ
がった。
dialogues.en: (She is sleeping.)
dialogues.text: (She is sleeping.)

dialogues.en:
She's resting her forehead on her hands, and underneath them
there's a book.
dialogues.text:
She's resting her forehead on her hands, and underneath them
there's a book.

dialogues.jp: 居間のテーブルで、頼子さんが突っ伏していた。
dialogues.en: (That's a......)
dialogues.text: (That's a......)

dialogues.jp: 「寝てる……のか？」
dialogues.en:
I lower my face towards her to peer at the corner of the
book that's showing through her hair. And her hair smells so
good.
dialogues.text:
I lower my face towards her to peer at the corner of the
book that's showing through her hair. And her hair smells so
good.

dialogues.jp:
何故か足音を殺して近づいていく。と、穏やか
な寝息が耳の中に忍び込んできた。
dialogues.en: ("...one tablespoon of Soy..." ......?)
dialogues.text: ("...one tablespoon of Soy..." ......?)

dialogues.jp: （寝てるのか）

両手を額の下に差し込み、そのさらに下には、
何かの本があった。
dialogues.en:
Oh, one tablespoon of Soy sauce... She's reading the cookery
book I gave her.
dialogues.text:
Oh, one tablespoon of Soy sauce... She's reading the cookery
book I gave her.

dialogues.jp: （ん、これは……）

｛わず／僅｝かに覗いている部分に、顔を寄せる。ふわっ
と髪の毛のいい匂いが漂ってくる。
dialogues.en:
I lift up my body and I looked at the back of her white
neck.
dialogues.text:
I lift up my body and I looked at the back of her white
neck.

dialogues.jp: （えーと、“──さじ１杯のしょう──”？）
dialogues.en:
Was she reading the book all through last night? Is that why
she looked so sleepy this morning?
dialogues.text:
Was she reading the book all through last night? Is that why
she looked so sleepy this morning?

dialogues.en: "She must be a hard worker......"
dialogues.text: "She must be a hard worker......"

dialogues.jp:
ああ、と心の中で手を打つ。大〔小〕さじ１杯
のしょう油ね。これは例の料理の本なのか。
dialogues.en:
And the fact that she did all of this hard work for me makes
me feel very happy, and also kind of tickled inside my body.
dialogues.text:
And the fact that she did all of this hard work for me makes
me feel very happy, and also kind of tickled inside my body.

dialogues.jp:
もしかして、ずっとこのムックを読んでいて、
だから朝も眠たそうだったんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
I grab a blanket from the piles of her bedclothes and put it
over her shoulders.
dialogues.text:
I grab a blanket from the piles of her bedclothes and put it
over her shoulders.

dialogues.jp: 徹夜までして？
dialogues.en: (It looks so......)
dialogues.text: (It looks so......)

dialogues.jp: 「努力家なんだな……」
dialogues.en:
The back of her long neck with a few stray hairs is
breathtakingly beautiful.
dialogues.text:
The back of her long neck with a few stray hairs is
breathtakingly beautiful.

dialogues.jp:
そして、その努力が自分に向けられたものだと
思うと、何だかくすぐったいような嬉しさを感
じてしまう。
dialogues.en: Her skin looks so soft and smooth.
dialogues.text: Her skin looks so soft and smooth.

dialogues.en:
Her hair that was tied up loosely in a bundle earlier is
down the side of her body, and it's showing a part of her
body she usually doesn't show.
dialogues.text:
Her hair that was tied up loosely in a bundle earlier is
down the side of her body, and it's showing a part of her
body she usually doesn't show.

dialogues.jp:
部屋の片隅に積まれた寝具から毛布を引っぱり
出し、そっと肩に掛けた。
（にしても……）
dialogues.en:
I feel a twitch in my right hand. It's the same desire I had
when I first saw her cat ears.
dialogues.text:
I feel a twitch in my right hand. It's the same desire I had
when I first saw her cat ears.

dialogues.jp:
すらっとしたうなじや、後れ毛に思わずごくり
と唾を飲み込んだ。
dialogues.en:
(Cat ears are also something that I don't see every
day......)
dialogues.text:
(Cat ears are also something that I don't see every
day......)

dialogues.jp:
陶器のようにきめ細やかな肌が、髪の毛へと続
いている。
dialogues.en:
I look at my right hand that's reaching towards her, and
feel like it is not my hand.
dialogues.text:
I look at my right hand that's reaching towards her, and
feel like it is not my hand.

dialogues.jp:
緩く｛あ／編｝まれた髪の束が身体の横へと流れていて、
普段は目にしない部分を｛あら／露｝わにしていた。
dialogues.en: And my hand reaches the back of her neck.
dialogues.text: And my hand reaches the back of her neck.

dialogues.jp:
右手がわきわきする。初めて会った際、ネコ耳
を目にした時にも身体を貫いた欲求。
dialogues.en:
I feel dizzy like lightheadedness or like having a
hemorrhage, and it makes my vision hazy and white.
dialogues.text:
I feel dizzy like lightheadedness or like having a
hemorrhage, and it makes my vision hazy and white.

dialogues.jp:
（ネコ耳も、普段──というか、普通は目にし
　ないもんな……）
dialogues.en:
It's only her smooth skin and the temperature I feel on my
finger that keep me in reality, or I could have drifted away
to somewhere unknown.
dialogues.text:
It's only her smooth skin and the temperature I feel on my
finger that keep me in reality, or I could have drifted away
to somewhere unknown.

dialogues.jp:
伸びていく右手を他人事のように見つめつつ、
ぼんやりとそんな事を思う。
dialogues.en: (I shouldn't fall into a delusion......)
dialogues.text: (I shouldn't fall into a delusion......)

dialogues.jp: そして、俺の手が頼子さんのうなじにあった。
dialogues.en:
I hear my own calm voice saying that from somewhere in my
brain. But it flies away like a petal of cherry blossom.
dialogues.text:
I hear my own calm voice saying that from somewhere in my
brain. But it flies away like a petal of cherry blossom.

dialogues.en: I want to touch more...
dialogues.text: I want to touch more...

dialogues.jp:
立ち｛くら／眩｝みのような、頭に血が上ったような感じ
で、視界が白い｛もや／靄｝に包まれる。

指先に感じる滑らかな肌と体温だけが、俺を現
実に繋ぎ止めている。それが無ければ、どこか
変な所へ流されてしまうような、そんな感じ。
dialogues.en: She twitches.
dialogues.text: She twitches.

dialogues.jp: （妄想じみてるぞ……）

頭の片隅で冷静なささやきが発せられたけれど
それは、桜の花びらのように散っていく。
もっと──。
dialogues.en: "Ah, hahaha...... Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Ah, hahaha...... Good morning."

dialogues.jp: ピクンッ。
dialogues.en:
Just like a student who got caught smoking by a teacher, I
quickly hide my hand behind my back.
dialogues.text:
Just like a student who got caught smoking by a teacher, I
quickly hide my hand behind my back.

dialogues.en:
Come to think of it, it's obviously a suspicious thing to
do, but it seems like Yoriko-san didn't notice it since
she's just woken up.
dialogues.text:
Come to think of it, it's obviously a suspicious thing to
do, but it seems like Yoriko-san didn't notice it since
she's just woken up.

dialogues.jp:
教師にタバコを見つかった学生みたく、素早く
手を後ろに隠す。
dialogues.en: She blinks several times and looks up at me.
dialogues.text: She blinks several times and looks up at me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はあ……」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... Good morning......"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... Good morning......"

dialogues.jp: 目をパチクリして、｛まぶ／眩｝しげに俺の顔を見上げる。
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……おはようございます……」
dialogues.en:
Fortunately, she didn't notice my early-stage molester
behavior. Whew!
dialogues.text:
Fortunately, she didn't notice my early-stage molester
behavior. Whew!

dialogues.en: Oh.
dialogues.text: Oh.

dialogues.jp:
｛あんど／安堵｝もつかの間、予想もし得なかった、人をま
ごつかせるシーンに出くわしてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Right after a brief moment of relief, I unexpectedly
encounter a perplexing situation.
dialogues.text:
Right after a brief moment of relief, I unexpectedly
encounter a perplexing situation.

dialogues.jp:
そのまままた眠ってくれ──そう願ったのだが、
叶わず、頼子さんは椅子から立ち上がった。
dialogues.en:
Please go back to sleep again... -- My wish doesn't come
true, and she stands up from the chair.
dialogues.text:
Please go back to sleep again... -- My wish doesn't come
true, and she stands up from the chair.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと……うたた寝してしまいました……」
dialogues.en: "I fell asleep...... I guess......"
dialogues.text: "I fell asleep...... I guess......"

dialogues.jp:
照れたような笑顔を向ける。普段なら嬉しいの
に今はまともに直視出来ない。
dialogues.en:
She smiles shyly. Usually I like that kind of smile but now
I can't look directly at her.
dialogues.text:
She smiles shyly. Usually I like that kind of smile but now
I can't look directly at her.

dialogues.jp: 「あーのさ、頼子さん……」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... Yoriko-san......"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... Yoriko-san......"

dialogues.jp: カーテンに目を向け、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: I look at the curtains and say,
dialogues.text: I look at the curtains and say,

dialogues.jp: 「口元、口元」
dialogues.en: "Your mouth..."
dialogues.text: "Your mouth..."

dialogues.jp:
きらりと光っていたのだ。焦りの気配が、ざわ
ざわと伝わってくる。
dialogues.en: It's shining. She looks very embarrassed.
dialogues.text: It's shining. She looks very embarrassed.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はうぅ……」

マッチ売りの少女でも、そこまで寒がらなかっ
たぞ──そうツッコミたくなるくらい、肌を擦
り付ける頼子さんがそこに居たのだった。
dialogues.en:
She wipes her mouth so many times that she could have wiped
her mouth off.
dialogues.text:
She wipes her mouth so many times that she could have wiped
her mouth off.

dialogues.jp: ◆頑張り屋◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
コーヒーでも飲もうかと、下に下りていくと、
頼子さんがうたた寝をしていた。
dialogues.en:
I murmur, imitating a southern accent for some reason, and I
get up from my bed.
dialogues.text:
I murmur, imitating a southern accent for some reason, and I
get up from my bed.

dialogues.jp:
毛布をかけてやった俺だが、その時目に入った
頼子さんのうなじに何故か衝動的に手を伸ばし
ていた。
dialogues.en: "Oh?"
dialogues.text: "Oh?"

dialogues.jp:
目を覚ました頼子さんは、挙動不審な俺のこと
には気がつかなかったようだが……。
dialogues.en: Yoriko-san's lying down on the living room table.
dialogues.text: Yoriko-san's lying down on the living room table.

dialogues.jp: ドキドキした。
dialogues.en: "Is she...... sleeping?"
dialogues.text: "Is she...... sleeping?"
